scripts.render:mp4: bun run render:video && bun run render:audio && node ../../ops/mux-film.mjs out/video.mp4 out/audio.wav out/wapi-demo.mp4
scripts.render:webm: bun run render:video-webm && node ../../ops/mux-film.mjs out/video.webm out/audio.wav out/wapi-demo.webm
scripts.render:poster: node ../../node_modules/@remotion/cli/remotion-cli.js still src/index.ts Demo out/poster.jpg --frame=900 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=88 --scale=2.2857142857 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/poster.jpg -vf scale=1280:-1 -q:v 4 ../web/public/demo-poster.jpg
scripts.render: bun run render:mp4 && bun run render:webm && bun run render:poster
